settings.question: How far back does it need to be?
settings.answer: Between [ MIN TO MAX DISTANCE ]. At [ DISTANCE ] the image is roughly [ IMAGE SIZE ], which covers a typical two-storey facade.

settings.question: Can it live outside in the rain?
settings.answer: It is rated [ CONFIRM INDOOR / OUTDOOR ]. Keep it under a porch roof or in a covered spot. It is not a unit to leave in the open through a storm.

settings.question: Does it need Wi-Fi or an app?
settings.answer: No. Scenes are on the unit and you change them with the remote. Nothing to pair, nothing to sign into.

settings.question: Will it work on light-coloured siding?
settings.answer: Yes, and it looks best on a flat, pale wall. Dark brick eats some brightness. Move it closer to keep the image tight and bright.

settings.question: Will it arrive before Halloween?
settings.answer: Yes if you order by [[cutoff]]. We ship tracked from inside the US within 24 hours. After that date we keep shipping but we stop promising the 31st. We'd rather tell you no than take your money on a maybe.

settings.question: Can I use it indoors the rest of the year?
settings.answer: Yes. It is an ordinary projector with Halloween scenes loaded. Point it at a wall inside and it works the same.

settings.question: What if it doesn't look like the video?
settings.answer: Send it back within 30 days and we refund you. No arguing, no restocking fee. No renders, no composites, no enhancement.
